name: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: AI Models and Application Development

fee.note: Additional taxes may apply in some countries.

exam.format: 50–60 multiple-choice questions; no hands-on lab; 60 minutes. Pass/fail; NVIDIA does not publish a passing score.

discounts.text: Attendees of NVIDIA's certification roadmap webinar on 19 November 2026 (one session for EMEA/APAC, one for the Americas and LATAM) receive a 50% discount code for an NVIDIA certification exam.

access.retake: After a failed attempt you buy the exam again and wait 14 days before retaking it, with at most five attempts per exam in 12 months.
access.accommodations: Non-native English speakers can ask for extra time (approved case by case) and candidates can ask for disability accommodations, both through an NVIDIA support case opened before the exam.

scope: AI model and application development fundamentals.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: NVIDIA's exam page lists the exam language as "Multiple" without naming the languages, while its certification FAQ says exams are in English and some also in Simplified Chinese, so no language is shown here.

timeline.text: NVIDIA's certification webinar sessions; attendees receive a 50% exam discount code.
